sections.body: A CIRCLE is round, like a plate. ⚪
A SQUARE has 4 straight sides, all the same. 🟦
A TRIANGLE has 3 sides and 3 corners. 🔺
A RECTANGLE has 4 sides, two long and two short, like a door. 🚪
Go on a shape hunt! Find a circle, a square and a triangle at home.
Name shapes in everyday things: wheels, windows, sandwiches cut in halves. Counting corners together builds early math.

quiz.q: How many sides does a triangle have?
hints: Tri- means three, like a tricycle has 3 wheels.
A square has 4 sides. A triangle has one less.

quiz.q: Which shape is round like a ball or a plate?
hints: It has no corners at all.
A wheel 🛞 is this shape too.
quiz.explain: A circle is round and has no corners. ⚪
